segments.ja491:1.1: Sace hi tyāhaṃ dhanahetu gāhito, mā maṃ vadhī jīvagāhaṃ gahetvā;
segments.ja491:1.3: Rañño ca [raññova (sī. pī.)] maṃ samma upantikaṃ [upanti (sī. syā. pī.)] nehi, maññe dhanaṃ lacchasinapparūpaṃ.
segments.ja491:2.1: Na me ayaṃ tuyha vadhāya ajja, samāhito cāpadhure [cāpavare (sī. pī.), cāpavaro (syā.)] khurappo;
segments.ja491:2.3: Pāsañca tyāhaṃ adhipātayissaṃ, yathāsukhaṃ gacchatu morarājā.
segments.ja491:3.1: Yaṃ satta vassāni mamānubandhi, rattindivaṃ khuppipāsaṃ sahanto;
segments.ja491:3.3: Atha kissa maṃ pāsavasūpanītaṃ, pamuttave icchasi bandhanasmā.
segments.ja491:4.1: Pāṇātipātā virato nusajja, abhayaṃ nu te sabbabhūtesu dinnaṃ;
segments.ja491:4.3: Yaṃ maṃ tuvaṃ pāsavasūpanītaṃ, pamuttave icchasi bandhanasmā.
segments.ja491:5.1: Pāṇātipātā viratassa brūhi, abhayañca yo sabbabhūtesu deti;
segments.ja491:5.3: Pucchāmi taṃ morarājetamatthaṃ, ito cuto kiṃ labhate sukhaṃ so.
segments.ja491:6.1: Pāṇātipātā viratassa brūmi, abhayañca yo sabbabhūtesu deti;
segments.ja491:6.3: Diṭṭheva dhamme labhate pasaṃsaṃ, saggañca so yāti sarīrabhedā.
segments.ja491:7.1: Na santi devā iti āhu [iccāhu (sī. pī.)] eke, idheva jīvo vibhavaṃ upeti;
segments.ja491:7.3: Tathā phalaṃ sukatadukkaṭānaṃ, dattupaññattañca vadanti dānaṃ;
segments.ja491:7.5: Tesaṃ vaco arahataṃ saddahāno, tasmā ahaṃ sakuṇe bādhayāmi.
segments.ja491:8.1: Cando ca suriyo ca ubho sudassanā, gacchanti obhāsayamantalikkhe;
segments.ja491:8.3: Imassa lokassa parassa vā te, kathaṃ nu te āhu manussaloke.
segments.ja491:9.1: Cando ca suriyo ca ubho sudassanā, gacchanti obhāsayamantalikkhe;
segments.ja491:9.3: Parassa lokassa na te imassa, devāti te āhu manussaloke.
segments.ja491:10.1: Ettheva te nīhatā hīnavādā, ahetukā ye na vadanti kammaṃ;
segments.ja491:10.3: Tathā phalaṃ sukatadukkaṭānaṃ, dattupaññattaṃ ye ca vadanti dānaṃ.
segments.ja491:11.1: Addhā hi saccaṃ vacanaṃ tavedaṃ [tavetaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)], kathañhi dānaṃ aphalaṃ bhaveyya [vadeyya (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja491:11.3: Tathā phalaṃ sukatadukkaṭānaṃ, dattupaññattañca kathaṃ bhaveyya.
segments.ja491:12.1: Kathaṃkaro kintikaro kimācaraṃ, kiṃ sevamāno kena tapoguṇena;
segments.ja491:12.3: Akkhāhi [akkhāhi taṃ dāni (ka.)] me morarājetamatthaṃ, yathā ahaṃ no nirayaṃ pateyyaṃ.
segments.ja491:13.1: Ye keci atthi samaṇā pathabyā, kāsāyavatthā anagāriyā te;
segments.ja491:13.3: Pātova piṇḍāya caranti kāle, vikālacariyā viratā hi santo.
segments.ja491:14.1: Te tattha kālenupasaṅkamitvā, pucchāhi yaṃ te manaso piyaṃ siyā;
segments.ja491:14.3: Te te pavakkhanti yathāpajānaṃ, imassa lokassa parassa catthaṃ.
segments.ja491:15.1: Tacaṃva jiṇṇaṃ urago purāṇaṃ, paṇḍūpalāsaṃ harito dumova;
segments.ja491:16.1: Ye cāpi me sakuṇā atthi baddhā, satāninekāni nivesanasmiṃ;
segments.ja491:16.3: Tesampahaṃ [tesaṃ ahaṃ (syā. ka.)] jīvitamajja dammi, mokkhañca te pattā [patto (sī.), accha (syā.)] sakaṃ niketaṃ.
segments.ja491:17.1: Luddo carī pāsahattho araññe, bādhetu morādhipatiṃ yasassiṃ;
segments.ja491:17.3: Bandhitvā [bandhitva (sī. pī.)] morādhipatiṃ yasassiṃ, dukkhā sa pamucci [dukkhā pamucci (sī.), dukkhā pamuñci (syā. pī.)] yathāhaṃ pamuttoti.
